recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-7394 unless a future work group decision changes the resource hierarchy or which resources derive from DomainResource.
issue_request: FHIR-7394 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking the Narrative page to make it obvious where narrative is found in a resource, specifically that narrative is included on DomainResource within concrete resource definitions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 6447, represented in git as cd7ca93d23bc4e013a3473ac634dc4266c282224. That commit changed source/narrative.html from saying each resource may include narrative to saying any domain resource may include narrative, with a link to the DomainResource page.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini makes the Narrative page and DomainResource active build-scoped inputs. Current source/narrative.html says any DomainResource, currently all resources except Bundle, Parameters, and Binary, may include narrative, and source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml defines DomainResource.text as the human-readable narrative element. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the issue request: the Narrative page identifies DomainResource as the resource type carrying narrative and links to the DomainResource definition containing the text element.
